span.p:
No methods: EF Core property classes.
Filled diamond = deleted with the case (Cascade).
Document to DocumentType: Restrict. Reviewer and
changed-by links: SetNull.
FilePath is a path on the API host's local disk
(wwwroot/uploads); files are not stored in the database.
